name: Famicom Bunko: Hajimari no Mori
original_name: ファミコン文庫 はじまりの森
source: While visiting a relative who lives in rural Japan, a young boy encounters a mysterious girl dressed in traditional Japanese clothes who seems to have no knowledge of modern technology.
translation: 一名少年去探望住在日本乡村的亲戚时，遇见了一位身穿传统和服的神秘女孩。她似乎对现代科技一无所知。
